findings.title: Pinned source and compile identities hold
findings.detail: 115/115 bound files match inputs.json. Solc 0.8.19 viaIR optimizer 999999 Paris bytecodeHash none. Geth evm 1.15.11. Morpho creation/runtime 16014/15582 bytes match p24-compile-readiness exactly in both diagnostic compiles. Fresh compile stdout is bit-identical to pinned compile.stdout. 27 git blob SHA-1 values recompute from snapshots.

findings.title: Five EVM cases replay bit-identically
findings.detail: Private-directory recompile then evm run of four public-call scenarios and one two-supplier probe returned exit 0. Decoded arrays match pinned results. Raw stdout SHA-256 matches original evidence for all five cases.

findings.title: Attempt 1 solc JSON DeclarationError despite process 0
findings.detail: Archived attempt-1 input recompiled to process exit 0 with DeclarationError 2904: WAD is not in ConstantsLib.sol. Bit-identical compile stdout. Zero EVM executions. Not a production Morpho defect and not execution credit.

findings.title: Attempt 2 genesis number 1 panics before code
findings.detail: Archived attempt2/paris-genesis.json has number 0x1. evm run exits 2 with panic can't commit genesis block with number > 0 and empty stdout. Stack pointer bytes differ across runs; panic text does not. Successful runner reuses the exact attempt-2 compile with block 0. Not a production Morpho defect and not execution credit.

findings.title: Healthy refusal asserts market and position structs only
findings.detail: Scenario 0 requires exact HEALTHY_POSITION and keccak256 of encoded Market and Position before/after. It does not compare global token balances or other storage. Observed structs are unchanged.

findings.title: Zero seized collateral is a returned quantity, not the input constraint
findings.detail: Scenario 1 requests seizedAssets 0 and repaidShares 1. UtilsLib.exactlyOneZero applies to that requested pair. Morpho returns seized 0, repaid 1; collateral remains 400; borrow assets 300 to 299. Do not treat returned seized 0 as a violation of exactly-one-zero.

findings.title: One extra borrow share reaches the actual min branch
findings.detail: Scenario 3 remaining-after-repay 907499999999999998; reconstructed unclamped conversion 907499999999999999; Morpho post-state borrow assets/shares and collateral 0; totalSupplyAssets falls by the remaining amount. The unclamped figure is a harness reconstruction using pinned SharesMathLib, not a Morpho return value.

findings.title: Rounded expectedSupplyAssets decreases are not market loss
findings.detail: Market supply assets 2 to 1 (loss 1). Pinned MorphoBalancesLib.expectedSupplyAssets via MorphoLib extSloads returns [1,1] then [0,0] (summed decrease 2). Each supplier keeps 1000000 shares. Counterexample only; no allocation policy or sequential withdrawal.

findings.title: expectedSupplyAssets feeRecipient caveat does not apply here
findings.detail: Owner is the probe at receiver 0x200. feeRecipient remains address(0). Market fee is 0. elapsed is 0 so interest is skipped. Suppliers are 0x1001 and 0x1002.

findings.title: Upstream liquidation tests are source references, not executed
findings.detail: LiquidateIntegrationTest.sol tests_executed 0. testBadDebtOverTotalBorrowAssets has no explicit post-state assertions. testSeizedAssetsRoundUp expects seized 0 / repaid 1. Tests use mocks and cheatcodes. Do not label these source tests newly passing.

findings.title: Configured Paris local runtime, not a deployed network
findings.detail: Genesis enables London and merge, omits shanghaiTime and cancunTime, block 0, timestamp 1. evm run injects harness runtime. Morpho is created with new Morpho(address(this)). No unobserved deployed-network or arbitrary-transaction reachability claim.

findings.title: Harness, launcher, and genesis-template pins are outside Morpho git blobs
findings.detail: Compiler-embedded production, mock, and periphery sources all match bound snapshots and recorded git blobs. Missing Morpho git blobs: root harnesses, geth launcher sources, and the p16 istanbul genesis template cited by runner-r3.py. IrmMock is pinned and unused. Resulting paris-genesis.json is hash-bound.

findings.title: Two-supplier probe exceeds 24576 bytes
findings.detail: Solc warning errorCode 5574: TwoSupplierProbe runtime 29052 bytes. Local evm run injects the runtime. Not a Morpho production bytecode defect and not a mainnet-deployability claim for the harness.

findings.title: No P24, task 25.1, Lean, or model acceptance
findings.detail: Usable diagnostic source evidence only. Allocation/remainder contract, mutants, interest, fees, callbacks, and supplier withdrawals remain open. A correctly scoped diagnostic does not require an extra full-program proof.
